evidence:
Sources read: frozen rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (read in memory via zipfile; Quality Checks row 8 / #7 'task_asks_for_a_real_working_product: Real build work is required; a stub or trivial tweak can't earn the reward.'; Internal Quality Checks sheet row 8 identical wording; the workbook has no comment/threaded-comment parts and its drawings carry no text; Deterministic Checks row 13 check-instruction-content.py is the related mechanical stub check), rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md and references/quality-checks.md section 7 ('ask what the smallest submission satisfying the brief would be'; defect = a static page, a single CRUD screen or a mock satisfies the ask), frozen template (instruction.md is 'CHANGE_ME'; template tests/scoring.toml and environment/Dockerfile), qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md, handoffs/LESSONS_FROM_COLDERWATER_2026-10-08.md, and the frozen task.

1) The ask is a large multi-surface build from an empty /app. task/environment/Dockerfile:17-23 creates /app holding only .gitkeep (template-identical); nothing of the product is pre-shipped. instruction.md:1-17 plus /instructions/hireops_rules.md sections 1-9 require: session auth with 401/403/404 semantics and four roles (rules.md:11-24, 68-74); job opening and candidate intake with validation and form preservation (rules.md:26-39); a six-stage board with one-step moves, reject/reopen-to-origin, manual ordering, Interview capacity, optimistic move with rollback and focus retention, and version-based 409 conflicts naming the actor (rules.md:41-88); atomic multi-card moves and constrained undo (rules.md:90-104); per-user browser-local note drafts (rules.md:106-111); an append-only Activity log (rules.md:113-119); live sync within 15 s that preserves focus/scroll/draft (rules.md:121-129); paged conversations with scroll anchoring, per-user unread and seen semantics, and per-user drafts surviving session expiry (rules.md:131-182); a data-minimised candidate portal (rules.md:184-203); SQLite persistence across restarts with seed-once (instruction.md:15-17; integration.md:1-23). The reference implementing this is about 1,570 lines across server.js, src/{bootstrap,db,index}.js and public/{index.html,styles.css,js/app.js,board.js,threads.js}.

2) Smallest submission that could earn any reward. tests/test.sh:68-69 exits after the zero reward written at :60 when /app/server.js is absent; an unreachable server likewise ends in write_zero_reward. Gates (scoring.toml [gates]; score.py:41 requires every gate; score.py:48 reward is 0 unless gates and floors pass): hro_gate_render (gates/render/judge.toml) needs a wrong-password refusal plus a valid sign-in to a usable staff workspace and states 'A static picture or only a health response is insufficient'; hro_gate_shared (gates/constraints/judge.toml) needs a UI-added candidate to survive a reload with the session intact and be found by the Observer in an independent browser context, rejecting 'A static seed response, a no-op success message or a browser-only save'. A static page, mock, health-only stub or browser-only store therefore scores 0. Floor: functional must exceed 0.05 (scoring.toml [floors]); functional weights total 61 (scored/functional/judge.toml:23-25), so more than 3.05 weight must pass, i.e. at least one substantial multi-leg criterion (e.g. hro_moves 4: one-step moves both ways through ordinary controls, skip refusals, bottom placement and cross-user consistent re-ordering) or two smaller ones (hro_activity 2 + hro_drafts 2). Polish and visual credit is unreachable without gates and floor (score.py:47-48). Even the minimum rewarded submission is a real server-backed, authenticated, multi-user app; a single CRUD screen cannot clear gates plus floor.

3) Weak apps tried against the text: (a) in-memory server without SQLite passes both gates (same process) and could earn some criteria, but hro_intake_restart (4.5) restarts via restart_app and fails; it is still real build work, so not a row-7 defect. (b) a gate-only app with sign-in, a board list and add-candidate but no moves clears the gates yet every one of the 15 functional criteria needs moves, roles, messaging or a restart, so functional is 0 and the floor zeroes the reward. (c) an app that statically renders seed data and fakes the add is blocked by the independent-context Observer readback in hro_gate_shared. Conforming alternative that could fail: for this row the real-build requirement does not depend on reference choices; any routes, labels, polling/SSE/sockets and non-drag controls are allowed (rules.md:3-5, 52, 129; app_context.md:37-38). Criterion-level false-fail behaviour belongs to other rows.

4) Colderwater lessons bearing on this row: lesson 4 (keep gates simple: load, reload, server-backed) is followed; the gates are sign-in/first render and add/reload/independent-context readback, with strictness kept in scored criteria, so they exclude dead apps without making hard features all-or-nothing. Lessons 3 and 5: difficulty comes from edge cases inside core features (stale 409, atomic bulk, undo invalidation, capacity, scroll anchoring, restart durability), and instruction.md:13 carries the self-check line. Lesson 2: functional weights 2-5.5 are documented as sums of 1.0/1.5/2.0 legs (functional/judge.toml:23-25); not a row-7 matter. No instance of a pattern that would let a stub or trivial tweak earn reward was found.

Evidence limits: raw-evidence-index.json hashes verified (all 8 artifact sha256 values and every matching_source_files hash match the current files and the frozen task bytes); its own scope says it holds only scripted golden observations and that reward discrimination/ranking, full configured judge grading, Oracle and model scores are absent. No measured stub/weak-app reward run exists. This Pass rests on the deterministic code paths in test.sh, score.py and scoring.toml and on the gate wording, which yield 0 for a missing server.js, a failed gate or a sub-floor functional score; how the configured judge actually decides the gates on a stub is not measured. That gap belongs to the pipeline's reward-discrimination record rather than to this row's judgement of the ask.
